summary: Verified the five legacy study_transcript_chunks stuck in transcribing are stale/orphaned, not legitimately active. All five are legacy/source=whisper, finished_processing_at is null, and their started_processing_at timestamps are 2026-09-10/11 while the active study-transcribe-v1 v6 state machine transitions transcribing -> ready|error inside a single Edge request and has no durable lease/heartbeat/resume worker. No transcript/provisional_text, participant content, room token, credential, or secret was read. No Supabase row was mutated because this /wc invocation authorizes reversible Prometeo repository writes, not external production-data mutation.

evidence.finding: POST upserts status=transcribing with started_processing_at, then in the same request updates the row to ready on success or error on failure; there is no durable lease, heartbeat, background resume, or retry owner.

tests: Queried information_schema only to enumerate table columns and explicitly avoided transcript, provisional_text, participant_name, participant_id, session_id values, room_token, and credentials.
Ran aggregate-only status/timestamp query and a metadata-only row query for status=transcribing.
Inspected the active Supabase Edge Function study-transcribe-v1 v6 source to establish the current transcribing -> ready|error state machine.
unresolved: The stale rows remain in transcribing because mutating Supabase production data is outside the current human authorization boundary.
An authorized database-write worker should perform a count-checked reversible repair and verify that exactly these five stale legacy rows leave transcribing without reading transcript content.

proposed_repair.intended_effect: For exactly the five currently stale legacy rows, change status from transcribing to error, set a bounded reconciliation marker in error, and set finished_processing_at; preserve transcript/provisional_text bytes unchanged.
safety_conditions: BEGIN transaction and lock only rows still status=transcribing, capture_version=legacy, source=whisper, finished_processing_at IS NULL, started_processing_at <= 2026-09-11T12:26:39.506Z.
Abort unless affected row count is exactly 5 and every targeted started_processing_at matches the five verified timestamps.
Do not select transcript, provisional_text, participant fields, room/session tokens, or credentials.
Record target IDs only in the authorized execution receipt if required for rollback; do not expose private content.
Rollback recipe: restore status=transcribing, error=NULL, finished_processing_at=NULL for the exact repaired IDs if downstream validation fails.
